How I Think

Hook Formulas
Pattern InterruptStart with something visually or verbally unexpected. Breaks autopilot scrolling.
Social Proof FirstLead with a comment, review or reaction — before showing the product.
Myth Bust"You think X, but actually Y." Creates curiosity + positions brand as authority.
Pain AgitateName the exact frustration. Let it breathe. Then offer relief.
Found FootageRaw, unpolished aesthetic signals authenticity — outperforms produced content for cold audiences.
Creative Principles
Never Lead ProductCold audiences don't care about your product. Lead with them.
Proof Before OfferSocial proof de-risks the decision. Always comes before the CTA.
Character SellsLet behavior and personality carry the message — not claims.
Loop for RetentionBuild an open loop in the first 3 seconds that gets resolved at the end.
One Job Per AdCold = awareness. Warm = consideration. Hot = conversion. Don't mix.
Audience Framework
Michael35–45, skeptical, practical. Needs proof. Hates fluff. Responds to logic + social proof.
Thomas28–38, aspirational. Wants to level up. Responds to identity-based messaging.
David22–30, trend-aware. Scrolls fast. Needs pattern interrupt in frame 1.
SarahGifter persona. Buys for partner. Responds to emotional storytelling + bundles.
Werner50+, quality-focused. Price-tolerant. Needs reassurance, not urgency.

Why Work With Me

01
I've Sold Before
I built and sold two ecom brands myself. I know what it's like to have your own money on the line. I don't theorize — I've been the founder stress-checking ROAS at midnight.
02
Strategy + Execution
Most strategists hand you a deck. I hand you ready-to-shoot scripts, briefs and creative direction — plus the thinking behind every decision.
03
I Speak Your Customer
I build detailed persona profiles before I write a single word. Your messaging is only as good as your understanding of who you're talking to.
04
Bold & Fast
No endless revisions, no corporate committees. I move fast, have a clear point of view, and I'm not afraid to kill a concept that isn't working.
05 —

The Human

24. Kiel. Creative by default, engineer by education.

I studied Industrial Engineering at CAU Kiel — which basically means I know how to think in systems and break problems down. Then I decided making things people actually want to buy was more interesting than materials science.

I founded bestfuture.de (plastic-free dishwasher tablets, sold 2024) and Strapiez.de (Apple Watch accessories). Running your own DTC brand teaches you more about ad creative than any agency ever could.

When I'm not building creative strategies, I'm kitesurfing, keeping my plants alive, or networking with people who are building something real.
